NBA DFS Rankings for Sunday, November 1 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 1 · 4 games · First game 3:30 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 1, 10:30 AM ET

Luka Doncic (LAL) ranks first on the Sunday, November 1 DraftKings main slate at 56.1 projected DraftKings points for $12,300. Jayson Tatum (BOS, 50.0) and Scottie Barnes (TOR, 46.0) are next.

The table ranks all 60 players in the run by SPAGS projection, with DraftKings salary and projected points per $1,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 1, 10:30 AM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.
